title: X03 Stage-A calibration probe: measured run-phase child peak RSS and engine walls at 4/6 threads, to decide whether a run-phase worker-shape candidate is admissible and worthwhile; accepts NO product change
frozen_before_timing: 2026-10-16, commit 9d02520b (probe findings recorded); no Stage-A timing has happened under this protocol. AMENDED after Stage-A job 14098252 completed (findings recorded) and BEFORE any Stage-A2 timing: adds the stage_a2 arms (8x3, 12x2 waves + engine_1x3, engine_1x2) so the Stage-B shape target is selected on measured data, not extrapolation

stage_a2_amendment.motivation: Stage-A measured nearly flat thread scaling (8->4 threads costs +5..14% engine) and RSS of ~0.75 GiB per child at every shape; the run-phase lever is wave count. Divisor shapes 8x3 (3 waves) and 12x2 (2 waves) project below 6x4's 1370 s engine makespan if contention stretch stays bounded; select on measurement.

arms.wave_8x3: 8 concurrent one-tile run jobs at threads_per_worker=3 (tiles 0_0..2_1 — needs an 8-tile subset); makespan + per-child ru_maxrss/seams; admission verdict recorded either way
arms.wave_12x2: 12 concurrent one-tile run jobs at threads_per_worker=2 (12-tile subset); same recording
arms.engine_1x3: standalone 1 worker x 3 threads, tile 0_0; wall + child seam (E3t)
arms.engine_1x2: standalone 1 worker x 2 threads, tile 0_0; wall + child seam (E2t)

stage_a2_amendment.subset: extended to 12 tiles (0_0, 1_0, 0_1, 1_1, 2_0, 0_2, 0_3, 1_2, 2_1, 3_0, 1_3, 2_2), every copied input sha256-asserted against the driver's embedded list; untimed walls/aspect/SVF prep for all 12
stage_a2_amendment.rules: same one-job allocation, prime, asserts, bitwise gate (TMRT_0_0 vs p2_ref), no-retry rule, diagnostic-only acceptance as the base protocol

change_under_test.summary: diagnostic-only calibration probe on the accepted X02+X01 state; product source frozen at the accepted diff

motivation.context: R11 probe (job 14097751) resolved the anomaly and set clean baselines: per-tile engine 264 s at 8 threads (86% day steps), thread ceiling at ~8 threads (1x24 = +1.5% only). The remaining measured lever for the run phase is the worker shape: more workers x fewer threads (e.g. 4x6 or 6x4) under the same 24-core budget.
motivation.bound: C6-42 phase admission prices one 1024^2/153-patch simulation job at ~6.94 GiB on the login node (3.20 GiB of it the GDAL cache allowance, host-RAM-derived) but the compute-node estimate differed (X02 E2E: 'only 3 jobs fit' at the live 36.4 GiB budget). Whether >3 concurrent run jobs fit must be decided by MEASURED child peak RSS on the compute node, not by the reservation model alone.
motivation.makespan_model: 24 tiles, engine-only: 3x8 -> 8*264 = 2112 s; 4x6 -> 6*E6t; 6x4 -> 4*E4t. Break-even at 4x6 needs E6t <= 528 s; at 6x4 needs E4t <= 528 s. Between 1 thread (492 s) and 8 threads (264 s) both are plausible; measured walls decide.

probe_design.one_job_same_node: single sbatch allocation (24 cores, 96G), arms in fixed order after untimed prime + scene prep (same 3-tile subset + sha asserts + untimed walls/aspect/SVF prep as the R11 probe)

arms.rss_3x8_baseline: 3 concurrent 1-tile run jobs at threads_per_worker=8 (the production condition); per-child ru_maxrss + seams; wall
arms.rss_4x6: 4 concurrent 1-tile run jobs at threads_per_worker=6; per-child ru_maxrss + seams; wall; admission verdict recorded either way
arms.rss_6x4: 6 concurrent 1-tile run jobs at threads_per_worker=4; per-child ru_maxrss + seams; wall; admission verdict recorded either way
arms.engine_1x6: standalone 1 worker x 6 threads, tile 0_0; wall + child seams (E6t)
arms.engine_1x4: standalone 1 worker x 4 threads, tile 0_0; wall + child seams (E4t)

recorded_per_arm: per-child ru_maxrss_kib + seams (hook extended with resource.getrusage ru_maxrss)
in-job admission constants: resolved budget bytes, default_gdal_cache_bytes, simulation_reservation total for the node
probe_design.concurrent_arms: the rss_* arms launch N separate 1-tile run_utci_tiles calls through N threads in-process (concurrent.futures), each with runtime_options(workers=1, threads_per_worker=T) so each spawns its own child; this is a probe-only dispatch, NOT a product route
asserts_before_timing: git merge-base --is-ancestor of the frozen commit
per-file sha256 of every subset input
probe_design.bitwise_criteria: every arm's TMRT_0_0 equal vs p2_ref_TMRT.tif; any diff aborts the probe

acceptance.stage_a_is_diagnostic_only: accepts NO product change and NO shape change
acceptance.go_condition_stage_b: all of: (a) measured per-child peak RSS at the production condition with a 1.5x safety margin fits >=4 concurrent jobs inside the node's live reservation base; (b) engine_1x6 or engine_1x4 walls project >=10% run-phase makespan reduction for an admitted shape; (c) the shape actually admits under the CURRENT C6-42 model on the compute node, OR the measured-RSS case for a reservation recalibration candidate is documented with the full numbers
acceptance.stage_b_requires: its own frozen protocol; if a reservation recalibration is proposed it is a review-gated product change to scheduling policy only (C6-42 semantics preserved: same reject policy, same ResourceAdmissionError surface, same public API), with alternatives and the S10 C6-42 decision record addressed; then a full E2E bitwise A/B vs the x01_b1 anchor (3838.3 s)
acceptance.no_go: if measured RSS approximates the reservation (model honest), the shape candidate is recorded REJECTED (admission, measured) and R11 narrows to within-engine scheduling/overlap only

environment.numba: NUMBA_CACHE_DIR shared with phases 0/1/2; threading_layer omp
environment.origin: repo .venv editable install of branch src; job echoes git rev-parse HEAD + product diff file list
